instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, schedules, sheets, and built-in export commands. Start from a blank Revit project. Using the Revit GUI, model a three-storey dormitory building with an overall rectangular footprint of 24.0 m by 12.0 m near the project origin. The exterior wall envelope should rise about 9.9 m, include one slab per storey, and have a roof covering the footprint above Level 3. Provide stairs that span from Level 1 through Level 3 along one side of the plan. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, three IfcBuildingStorey entities, eighteen IfcSpace entities, twelve IfcWall entities, three IfcSlab entities, one IfcRoof, fifteen IfcDoor entities, fifteen IfcWindow entities, and three IfcStair entities. Do not include IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include at least three corridors, twelve bedrooms, and three bathrooms. Export a two-page Revit sheet PDF named result.pdf with a typical floor plan and a section; its sheet text must include A101 TYPICAL FLOOR PLAN, A301 SECTION, Level 3, Level 2, and Level 1. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
